_comment: Baseline run: 3 hand-picked production pipelines (pipelines/*.json), no parameter sweep, same generation set for all three. LensCorrection_CUDA/ProjectPointTo2DSurface_CPU disabled in these pipeline copies since ground truth is raw synthetic pixel space, incompatible with the real-camera lens calibration those two steps otherwise apply. Container-ready as-is (see Containerfile.sim); for host use, edit pipeoptimizer_bin to your local build/bin/pipeoptimizer.
